name: Bacchus & Barleycorn
description: Homebrew supply shop serving the Kansas City area since 1968, stocking ingredients and equipment for beer, wine, mead, cider, cheesemaking, and kombucha.

name: Grains & Taps Home Brew Supply
description: Homebrew supply shop selling beer and wine ingredient kits, grain, malt extract, hops, yeast, and brewing and bottling equipment.

name: Kansas City Bier Meisters
description: Homebrew club founded in 1983, with members who also make mead and cider. Meets the third Friday of each month; guests are welcome.

name: Johnson County Brewing Society
description: Homebrew club open to brewers of all experience levels and anyone curious about homebrewing. Meets the fourth Thursday of most months.

name: ZZ Hops Home Brewing Club
description: Homebrew club for all levels, meeting the third Monday of each month around Lee's Summit, with hands-on brewing sessions and brewery field trips.

name: KC Sourdough Co.
description: Hands-on sourdough baking classes held at local venues, plus private classes for groups of four or more.

name: Somerset Ridge Vineyard & Winery
description: Family-owned farm winery making wine from Kansas-grown grapes, plus hard cider.

name: NightHawk Vineyard & Winery
description: Boutique Miami County winery with a tasting room open on weekends.

name: Fossil Springs Elderberry Farm & Winery
description: Elderberry farm and winery making fruit wines from only the fruit named on the label, with a tasting room.

name: Louisburg Cider Mill
description: Cider mill and country store making hard cider and perry from Kansas-grown apples, with a tasting room.

name: The Peculiar Winery
description: Family-owned winery making more than twenty grape and fruit wines, fermented and bottled on its 15-acre property.
